ev.q: Aliens: Colonial Marines is a 2013 first-person shooter
based on the Alien science fiction horror film series
campaign mode that supports both single-player and cooperative gameplay
a multiplayer mode in which players compete in different scenarios
Colonial Marine ranks unlock weapon upgrades for use in both the campaign and the competitive multiplayer modes
Xenomorphs are fast and primarily attack with their claws or by spitting acid
features 11 missions that involve players moving from one checkpoint to another
